issues.title: Ingest Sharp County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $10,682,375 across 38 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($3,902,714), County Road Fund ($3,312,024), 1/4 Cent Jail Facility Fund Sales Tax ($1,017,664). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.

issues.title: Reconcile Courthouse Maintenance (County General Fund)
issues.detail: The categories add to $147,647.00. The page then subtracts $19,667.00 charged to the Collector, Treasurer and Assessor and prints 'Cost to General' $127,980.00, the amount the ordinance appropriates. Printed total is $127,980.00; the categories listed add to $147,647.00. Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.
